scripts.build: tsc -p apps/dashboard/tsconfig.json && vite build apps/dashboard && node scripts/check-dashboard-build.mjs
scripts.build:staging: tsc -p apps/dashboard/tsconfig.json && vite build apps/dashboard --mode staging && node scripts/check-dashboard-build.mjs apps/dashboard/dist-staging
